transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our routine sustainment huddle started. We've got a 10,000-liter water tanker arriving at 0800 today. Standard allocations are 4,500 for dining, 2,500 for the clinic, 2,000 for maintenance, and 1,000 to reserve storage. S-4 and maintenance chief, give me your operational updates so we can finalize the distribution plan and get orders released.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a change to the standard distribution plan. I confirmed this morning that the clinic's sterilizer-validation cycle requires exactly 700 liters above its standard 2,500-liter allocation today. That additional 700 liters must be drawn from reserve storage, which reduces reserve from 1,000 to 300 liters. Dining services remains at its standard 4,500. This updated clinic figure has not yet been entered on the water request slide, so the slide still shows the old numbers.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, from the maintenance side, our standard 2,000-liter allocation is sufficient for today's tasks. I do have a timing detail from the maintenance work package that needs to be captured in the distribution order: a vehicle-washdown block requires exactly 1,200 liters of our allocation released by 1400, with the remaining 800 liters released by 1800. That timing hasn't been added to the distribution order yet, so I want to make sure it's on there before orders go out.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the water request slide to reflect clinic allocation of 3,200 liters and reserve storage of 300 liters before distribution orders are released.
Include maintenance timing details in the distribution order: 1,200 liters released by 1400 and 800 liters released by 1800.
